description: Audit napoleon-remastered and warscape-core for every prose rule a machine can check or perform; turn each into a gate, schema rule, default or verb with a failing-fixture test; ledger in jobs/J5/rules.md; core-side fixes as a warscape-core PR. Sequencing, not a technical dependency: after J3 merges, so its tools, headers and registry rows are audited and J5 does not conflict with it; before the J13-J15 briefs so they are written against the new gates.
title: Determinism audit: rules into gates
